source_snapshot.items: EC.15_GPU Device Reset: 25x Warm Reboot Cycles
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; permits PASS inheritance from SY.1; collect results/photos and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All GPU PCIe links train to maximum supported generation at x16 with no correctable or uncorrectable errors.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 720 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires NVIDIA toolchain, operator-controlled warm reboot and per-iteration evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for exact reboot primitive, 25 iterations, topology/max-link matrix, SY.1 mapping and recovery.

old_problem: Warm reboot was not bound to a single reset primitive; kexec, BMC reset, cold reset, S5 and power cycling exercise different paths. A final state or generic SY.1 PASS could hide boot loops, driver bind failures, intermittent missing GPUs, downtraining or corrected errors.
disposition_reason: The source unambiguously requires 25 warm reboots. ED-06/19 preserve that mechanism separately from cold/AC/DC/device reset. Exact approved OS reboot command, deadlines, topology and SY.1 artifact mapping are Project Configuration and can close the execution gate without keeping review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2147, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2148 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00025-V002 / 01b324edb7b5599b was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind one approved warm-reboot primitive and explicitly exclude kexec, BMC cold reset, S5, AC/DC cycle and device reset unless the source is revised.
Bind GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF-to-root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 oracle plus shutdown, firmware, OS and driver readiness deadlines.
Execute exactly 25 numbered supervised reboots; after each ready state preserve complete GPU/link/AER/driver/OS/BMC evidence before another reboot.
Preserve logs and first-fault state. Stop on timeout/boot loop, missing GPU, driver failure, downtraining, any disqualifying new error or lost recovery access; never retry automatically.
SY.1 equivalence requires the identical warm-reboot primitive and all 25 complete per-cycle artifacts; aggregate PASS is insufficient.
No reboot, GPU/link query, log clearing, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Twenty-five-cycle warm-reboot GPU PCIe recovery qualification
test_case.purpose: Prove every expected GPU re-enumerates and every PCIe link retrains to its signed maximum generation at x16 with zero new correctable or uncorrectable errors after each of 25 approved warm reboots.
required_package: Signed warm-reboot command/semantics and readiness deadlines
Twenty-five-cycle ledger and exact SY.1 artifact mapping
Dedicated drained SUT, operator, BMC/console and failed-boot recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash baseline evidence. Under operator supervision execute exactly 25 instances of the approved warm-reboot primitive. After each firmware/OS/driver-ready transition capture complete GPU inventory, link capability/current generation/x16, AER, NVIDIA/driver, kernel/journal and BMC/SEL/health evidence before proceeding. Stop on first deviation; do not substitute another reset, clear logs or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 25 warm reboots complete by deadline; every expected GPU returns with stable identity and healthy driver, every link reaches signed maximum generation x16, zero disqualifying correctable/uncorrectable errors occur, and no boot loop or abnormal platform state appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until reboot primitive, readiness, topology and SY.1 equivalence are signed. PASS requires all 25 complete accepted ledgers. FAIL on wrong reset type, timeout/boot loop, missing/misbound GPU, driver failure, downtraining, new disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; later reboot or aggregate SY.1 cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact warm-reboot primitive, readiness/oracle, cycle ledger and recovery are signed.
Use a drained dedicated SUT with console/BMC and authorized operator.
Preserve baseline and first-fault evidence across reboots.
Stop without another reboot or automatic retry on first fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, tool versions, reboot primitive and SY.1 traceability
Per-cycle GPU inventory, link capabilities/LnkSta/AER, NVIDIA/driver, kernel/journal, BMC/SEL and health artifacts
First-fault/recovery or stable post-cycle-25 state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On timeout, boot loop, missing GPU, driver failure, downtraining, AER or lost access, inhibit further reboots and preserve the failed state. Do not switch reset class or retry automatically; follow signed BMC/console recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.
